notes.title: GENOME BREACH NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zwnSVyPcLxA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]GENOME BREACH[/h1]
[h2]A rogue-lite experience in Chimera CUSTOM XG[/h2]

THE BREACH IS OPENING! You're the latest test subject in our high-stakes experiment to create the ultimate super soldier. Lucky You!

Drop in to procedurally generated combat sims packed with alien freaks, killer drones, and whatever else we cooked up in the lab. Blast through the chaos, stack up buffs and push your genome to the limit.

With every challenge you overcome, Randi will offer rewards to tweak your loadout and juice your build. Start your runs as a blank C.U.S.T.O.M. clone. Find loot, grab it, and use it. That simple. No inventory, no item management, just pure destruction!

Now available for all players!

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes 3.21.25
Version: 0.1.1

Fixed Issues:
- HQ Progression: Cobb now says her unique into dialogue every time, the Mission Pad is no longer inaccessible due to the soft lock.
- Giza Lab: All waves spwan every time, Player is no longer soft locked.
- Reptoids and High Value Targets: Now have updated grenade effects.
- Loot Drop Rates: Adjusted with more opportunity for mods, even on Commons.
- New informative load screen tool tips!
- Side mission end of mission clean up, pardon the dust.

On Radar:
- Missions ending and no opportunity to pick up loot, we're reevaluating how end of mission functions.
- Some collision issues and areas Players are not supposed to go resulting in death.
- Some UI navigation issues and confusing wording.
- Boss fights with far too aggressive behaviors.

If you have reported a bug, issue, or suggestion it's in our log. Have a great weekend!
